arxiv-1802-09717.title: A multi-step approximant for fixed point problem and convex
arxiv-1802-09717.creator: optimization problem in Hadamard spaces
arxiv-1802-09717.description:
A 2018 arXiv research paper by optimization problem in Hadamard spaces. Abstract
: The purpose of this paper is to propose and analyze a
multi-step iterative algorithm to solve a convex optimization problem and a
fixed point problem posed on a Hadamard space. The convergence properties of
the proposed algorithm are analyzed by employing suitable conditions on the
control sequences of parameters and the structural properties of the under
lying space.

arxiv-2111-05771.title: A classification of nonexpansive Bratteli-Vershik systems
arxiv-2111-05771.creator: Karl Petersen, Sandi Shields
arxiv-2111-05771.description: Abstract . We study simple, properly ordered nonexpansive Bratteli-Vershik ( B ​ V BV ) systems. Correcting a mistake in an earlier paper, we redefine the classes standard nonexpansive ( S ​ N ​ E SNE ) and strong standard nonexpansive ( S ​ S ​ N ​ E SSNE ).

arxiv-2210-11426.title: Promise of Future Searches for Cosmic Topology
arxiv-2210-11426.creator: Yashar Akrami, Stefano Anselmi, Craig J. Copi, Johannes R. Eskilt, Andrew H. Jaffe, Arthur Kosowsky, Pip Petersen, Glenn D. Starkman, Kevin González-Quesada, Özenç Güngör, Deyan P. Mihaylov, Samanta Saha, Andrius Tamosiunas, Quinn Taylor, Valeri Vardanyan, COMPACT Collaboration
arxiv-2210-11426.description: Abstract The shortest distance around the Universe through us is unlikely to be much larger than the horizon diameter if microwave background anomalies are due to cosmic topology. We show that observational constraints from the lack of matched temperature circles in the microwave background leave many possibilities for such topologies.

arxiv-2402-19133.title: Evaluating Webcam-based Gaze Data as an Alternative for Human Rationale Annotations
arxiv-2402-19133.description: Abstract Rationales in the form of manually annotated input spans usually serve as ground truth when evaluating explainability methods in NLP. They are, however, time-consuming and often biased by the annotation process. In this paper, we debate whether human gaze, in the form of webcam-based eye-tracking recordings, poses a valid alternative when evaluating importance scores.

arxiv-2406-14336.title: Exploring Spatial Representations in the Historical Lake District Texts with LLM-based Relation Extraction
arxiv-2406-14336.creator: Erum Haris, Anthony G. Cohn, John G. Stell
arxiv-2406-14336.description: Abstract Navigating historical narratives poses a challenge in unveiling the spatial intricacies of past landscapes. The proposed work addresses this challenge within the context of the English Lake District, employing the Corpus of the Lake District Writing. The method utilizes a generative pre-trained transformer model to extract spatial relations from the textual descriptions in the corpus.

arxiv-2505-02838.title: Non-Archimedean Heisenberg-Robertson-Schrodinger and Non-Archimedean Maccone-Pati Uncertainty Principles
arxiv-2505-02838.creator: K. Mahesh Krishna
arxiv-2505-02838.description: Abstract Abstract : Let \mathcal{X} be a non-Archimedean Hilbert space over a conjugated non-Archimedean valued field \mathbb{K} with \operatorname{Char}(\mathbb{K})\neq 2 . Let A:\mathcal{D}(A)\subseteq\mathcal{X}\to\mathcal{X} and B:\mathcal{D}(B)\subseteq\mathcal{X}\to\mathcal{X} be possibly unbounded self-adjoint linear operators. For x\in\mathcal{D}(A) with \langle x,x\rangle=1 , define \Delta_{x}(A)\coloneqq\|Ax-\langle Ax,x\rangle x\|.

pmc-10530047.title: Benefits of Combining Sonchus brachyotus DC. Extracts and Synbiotics in Alleviating Non-Alcoholic Fatty Liver Disease
pmc-10530047.creator: Wenwu Huang, Boyuan Shen, Xiumei Li, Tongcun Zhang, Xiang Zhou
pmc-10530047.description: Non-alcoholic fatty liver disease, commonly abbreviated to NAFLD, is a pervasive ailment within the digestive system, exhibiting a rising prevalence, and impacting individuals at increasingly younger ages. Those afflicted by NAFLD face a heightened vulnerability to the onset of profound liver fibrosis, cardiovascular complications, and malignancies.

pmc-10595499.title: Trends in acute hospital smoking prevalence and support of campus ban in Dublin, Ireland (1997-2018)
pmc-10595499.creator: A Mattson, A Lyons, K Doherty, A Douglass, S Stynes, M Kerley, P Fitzpatrick, C Kelleher
pmc-10595499.description: BackgroundSt Vincent's University Hospital (SVUH), a major hospital in Dublin, Ireland pioneered a hospital smoke-free campus policy in 2009; pre/post this intervention it conducted periodic surveys of patients, staff & visitors for smoking prevalence and policy attitudes. As rates of smoking decline nationally in Ireland, it is important to monitor trends for at-risk groups, including lower socioeconomic status (SES).

pmc-11476447.title: Crosslinked All-Femtosecond Laser-Cut Corneal Allogenic Intracorneal Ring Segments (AFXL CAIRSs): Pilot Ex Vivo Study and Report of First Two Cases Performed in Italy
pmc-11476447.creator: Cosimo Mazzotta, Marco Zagari, Giulia Bona, Diego Ponzin, Shady T Awwad, Emilio A Torres-Netto, Farhad Hafezi, Soosan Jacob, Kyung Chul Yoon, Brent Siesky
pmc-11476447.description: Objectives: This pilot ex vivo study and first clinical experience in Italy evaluate the impact of using pre-implantation crosslinking on all-femtosecond laser-cut corneal allogenic intracorneal ring segments (AFXL CAIRSs). Methods: Six human donor eye-bank corneas were used for this preclinical ex vivo human study. Three donor (D) corneas were used for AFXL CAIRSs.

pmc-11745178.title: Sevelamer-induced Gastrointestinal Mucosal Injury: A Critical Review for Clinicians
pmc-11745178.creator: Lefika Bathobakae, Phenyo Phuu, Saif Yasin, Rammy Bashir, Jessica Escobar, Ruhin Yuridullah, Gabriel Melki, Mohamed Elagami, Kamal Amer, Yana Cavanagh, Walid Baddoura
pmc-11745178.description: Sevelamer is a non-absorbable polymer used to treat hyperphosphatemia in individuals with end-stage renal disease (ESRD) undergoing hemodialysis. The deposition of sevelamer crystals in the gastrointestinal (GI) tract, especially in the colon, can cause mucosal inflammation, pseudopolyps, ulceration, ischemia, or necrosis.

pmc-12619306.title: Digital interventions in nutrition education: a web-based model for promoting sustainable nutrition among young adults
pmc-12619306.creator: Feray Gençer Bingöl, Özge Nur Çakmak, Rabia Bayrak, Selver Doğan
pmc-12619306.description: BackgroundIn light of increasing environmental problems, food safety risks and healthy living requirements, sustainable nutrition has become a priority for individuals and societies. In this context, the present study aims to develop a web-based educational program to promote sustainable dietary habits for young adults and to evaluate the effectiveness of this program.

pmc-12650129.title: Children with Dyslexia Benefit from Short Combined Reading and Motor Training: Objective Measures Assessed by Eye Movements and Postural Sway Recordings
pmc-12650129.creator: Simona Caldani, Elie Khoury, Richard Delorme, Maria Pia Bucci, Ana Paula Soares
pmc-12650129.description: Background/Objectives: Children with dyslexia report poor motor control; several studies have shown poor eye movements control during reading and important body instability in these children. The present study aimed to test in children whether reading and postural abilities in children with dyslexia could benefit from a short combined reading and postural training program.

pmc-13049977.title: Control of pyrethroid-resistant Anopheles gambiae s.l. with Sovrenta® 15WP, a new isoxazoline insecticide for indoor residual spraying
pmc-13049977.creator: Renaud Govoetchan, Abel Agbevo, Juniace Ahoga, Hospice Avanon, Thomas Syme, Boris N’dombidge, Victoria Ariori, Damien Todjinou, Laurette Kiki, Corine Ngufor
pmc-13049977.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). IntroductionAn expanded portfolio of more effective WHO-prequalified insecticides for indoor residual sparing (IRS) is needed to provide additional options to disease control programmes and enhance their capacity to efficiently apply IRS rotations for managing vector resistance to insecticides.

pmc-13176459.title: Advances in hydrogel-mediated gene therapy in ophthalmology: future directions and therapeutic potential
pmc-13176459.creator: Qinghe Zhang, Ke Yan, Yufei Lv, Tao Tao, Shinan Wu, Zixuan Yang, Linyan Ma, Caihong Huang, Qiuping Liu, Yi Han, Zuguo Liu
pmc-13176459.description: Hydrogel-mediated gene therapy has achieved significant progress in the field of ophthalmology in recent years. As three-dimensional polymeric networks with high water content, hydrogels exhibit excellent biocompatibility, localized targeting capability and sustained-release properties. These characteristics make them ideal carriers for nucleic acid-based drugs, including DNA, RNA and gene editing systems.
